# sonde

> sonde records what a program does to S3 (its requests, through a local endpoint) and explains it: findings with
> the line of code that sent them and the fix, what fixing them saves, and whether a fix worked. A CLI, a desktop
> app and a GitHub Action.

For a coding agent: `sonde run -o r.sonde -- <command>`, then `sonde show r.sonde -f json`; apply `diagnoses[0].fix`
at `diagnoses[0].at[].file:line`, run the same command again, and read `since.findings[].state`.

## Docs

- [For coding agents](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/agents.md): the loop, the fields, the exit codes
- [CLI](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/cli.md): every command and flag
- [JSON schemas](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/tree/main/docs/schemas): every `-f json` output
- [What is stable](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/contract.md)
- [Recording](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/recording.md): how a program's requests reach sonde
- [Trials](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/trials.md): a program under faults
- [CI](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/ci.md): `sonde check` and the GitHub Action
- [Configuration](https://github.com/hxddh/sonde/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): `sonde.toml` and `config.toml`
